Lloyd Greif Center for Entrepreneurial Studies

The Lloyd Greif Center for Entrepreneurial Studies is the hub for entrepreneurship at USC. We are world-class entrepreneurship educators, collaborators, knowledge creators, and venture catalysts. Along with our curricular offerings, we provide co-curricular activities that engage student entrepreneurs, startup enthusiasts, students in general, and campus leaders. These activities support students from opportunity recognition through succession/exit. Our organized programming includes: the Blackstone LaunchPad, New Venture Seed Competition, Athena Initiative, Marshall Greif Incubator, Startup Survival Workshop Series, Catalyst Microgrant program, eCouncil, the Marshall Venture Fund, and more.
